info.title: DevBox API
info.summary: The only interface between the DevBox core and its frontends (web UI, CLI, terminal menu).
info.description: The contract covers the web UI milestone (AP-09 subset): info, plugins, checks, settings, credentials (read only), sessions, the WebSocket and the embedded schemas. Authentication, profiles, groups, setup and catalog endpoints follow. All responses are JSON with camelCase fields and RFC 3339 UTC times; errors use RFC 9457 problem details with a stable code.

X-DevBox-Next-Seq.description: Every output chunk with a sequence number below this value is contained in the body.

post.summary: Stop a queued or running session.
post.description: Errors: 404 not-found for an unknown session, 409 conflict when it has finished.

202.description: The session as of the cancel request; it ends as stopped.

get.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket. Client messages follow WsClientMessage, core messages WsServerMessage. The Origin header is required and must be allowed; otherwise 403 csrf. Clients subscribe to topics (checks, sessions, settings, session:<id>); output and events of a session carry a sequence number (seq) and can be replayed with fromSeq. Both sides send a ping every 30 seconds.

DevBoxRequest.name: X-DevBox-Request
DevBoxRequest.description: Required on every modifying request (CSRF protection), together with a matching Origin.

Lang.description: Language tag, e.g. de or pt-BR.

Name.description: Identifier of a plugin, credential instance, repository or schema.

desktop.description: Desktop environment in lower case, e.g. gnome.

Info.description: Version, host, authentication mode, protocol version and features of the core.

vendor.description: Always zenit-hosting; distinguishes DevBox from other tools named devbox.

home.description: Home directory of the user the core runs as; the UI shortens paths below it to ~.

features.description: Optional features of this build: ui = an embedded UI build is present, ws = the WebSocket is available, socket = the Unix socket is listening.

ui.description: The ui section of the configuration file; the user file wins over the system file.

label.description: Label of the check from the manifest, untranslated.

details.description: Label-value pairs of the check result.

hints.description: Hints of the check result, optionally with a direct action.

data.description: Structured data of the check result.

StatusReport.description: Overview of all checks; also the output of devbox status --json.

running.description: Checks that are running right now.

ChecksRefresh.description: Checks to run again; without ids all checks run.

lang.description: Language of the run (DEVBOX_LANG); default is ui.language of the configuration.

SettingLayer.description: Value of a setting in one configuration layer.

layer.description: plugin, system, profile:<id>, user, env or call.

SettingExplain.description: Effective value of a setting and every layer it was merged from; also the output of devbox config explain --json.

origin.description: Layer the effective value comes from.

SettingsPatch.description: User values to set; null removes the user value.

yes.description: The user confirmed the confirm prompt of the action; also passed to the plugin as Spec.Yes.

lang.description: Language of the run (DEVBOX_LANG); default is ui.language of the configuration.

Session.description: Summary of a session; also a line of the history (devbox history --json) and the payload of the WebSocket message "session".

dryRun.description: The session is a dry run.

exitCode.description: Exit code of the process; null when it did not exit by itself.

nextSeq.description: Live sessions only: the sequence number the next output chunk or event will take.

SecretPut.description: New secret of a credential instance.

secret.description: Token or password; never returned by the API.

ProblemError.description: One field error of a problem.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer of the field in the request body.

code.description: Stable error code of the field.

Problem.description: Error in RFC 9457 format with a stable code.

PluginState.description: State of a plugin; only ready plugins offer actions.

PluginReason.description: Why a plugin is not ready, or a note about it. code is stable and translated by the frontends.

detail.description: Subject of the reason: command, plugin and range, setting key, disabling layer or error location.

PluginStatus.description: A found plugin with its state.

shadowed.description: Directories of later plugins with the same ID that this one replaces.

PluginList.description: All found plugins, sorted by ID. manifest and resolvedDefaults appear only with ?manifest=true.

PluginDetail.description: A plugin with its manifest (absent when the manifest is invalid).

shadowed.description: Directories of later plugins with the same ID that this one replaces.

manifest.description: The plugin manifest (schema/plugin.v1.json). Only with ?manifest=true on the list.

resolvedDefaults.description: Defaults of the action parameters with placeholders resolved, keyed by action name and parameter name. A parameter whose default cannot be resolved is left out. Only with ?manifest=true on the list.

Messages.description: Flat translation map of a plugin (plugins/<id>/i18n/<lang>.json without $schema and $comment).

SettingItem.description: A setting with its definition, effective value and lock.

field.description: The field definition from the manifest (schema/plugin.v1.json#/$defs/field): label, help, default, enum, format, advanced, optionsFrom, secret.

value.description: Effective value; absent when the setting has neither a value nor a default.

origin.description: Layer of the effective value; absent when there is no value.

lockedBy.description: The locking profile; only when locked.

SettingList.description: All settings of the found plugins, sorted by key.

CredentialInstance.description: A credential instance with profile and user parts merged; never contains the secret itself. Also the item of devbox cred list --json.

origin.description: Who created the instance: user or profile:<id>.

consumers.description: Consumer options keyed by plugin ID.

secret.description: Reference to the secret in the vault.

applied.description: When each consumer last applied the instance, keyed by plugin ID.

CredentialList.description: All credential instances; also the output of devbox cred list --json.

SessionList.description: Sessions, newest first; also the output of devbox history --json.

next.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

SessionEvent.description: One line of sessions/<id>.events.jsonl. The protocol message itself is described in schema/event.v1.json#/$defs/message.

SessionEventList.description: All protocol messages of a session in sequence order.

WsSubscribe.description: Client to core: subscribe to topics.

fromSeq.description: Replay from this sequence number; applies to every session:<id> topic of the message.

WsInput.description: Client to core: keyboard input for the terminal of a session.

data.description: Input, base64; at most 64 KiB decoded.

WsResize.description: Client to core: new terminal size of a session.

WsClientMessage.description: Every message a client may send.

WsOutput.description: Core to client: a chunk of terminal output, secrets masked.

WsEvent.description: Core to client: a protocol message of a session.

WsSession.description: Core to client: a session was created or changed.

WsCheck.description: Core to client: a check result changed.

WsGap.description: Core to client: the requested fromSeq is older than the in-memory buffer. Streaming continues at firstSeq; the client reloads GET /sessions/{id}/log.

WsError.description: Core to client: a client message was refused.

WsServerMessage.description: Every message the core may send.
